Loss report: gitlab -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.api (the source runs on the events api, trigger and its file has no trigger form for them; Concourse has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.pipeline_done (the source runs on the events pipeline, parent_pipeline and its file has no trigger form for them; Concourse has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.resource (the source runs on the events external, chat and its file has no trigger form for them; Concourse has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.schedule (the source runs on the events schedule and its file has no trigger form for them; Concourse has no event for them, and the file names no schedule to copy)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci trigger.tag (no job copy can wait for a tag version, because the pipeline has no job or its push trigger is not a git resource; a job waits for a version of every get, so with a push trigger beside the tag trigger the job never starts)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable; placeholder job (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager; the pipeline has no jobs, and a Concourse pipeline needs one; the job placeholder runs true)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.env: copied into the params of every task (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/placeholder trigger.push: workspace from the first triggering resource (the tasks run in the checkout of source, and every build uses the newest version of each resource, so a push to source-tags builds the newest commit of source)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/placeholder/step/placeholder step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/placeholder/step/placeholder step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/2 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
